The history of 19th-century Western expansion, as seen through the lives of three generations of a pioneer family.
programme.title: How the West Was Won

programme.desc: A recluse mountain man becomes the unwilling object of a long vendetta by Indians, and proves to be a match for their warriors.
programme.title: Jeremiah Johnson

programme.desc: A witch's (Kim Novak) warlock brother (Jack Lemmon) helps a San Francisco publisher (James Stewart) break a love spell.
programme.title: Bell, Book and Candle

programme.desc: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.
programme.title: Capricorn One

programme.desc: A paratrooper's (Dean Martin) goofy buddy (Jerry Lewis) joins him on base and makes a mockery of maneuvers.
programme.title: Jumping Jacks

programme.desc: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve.
programme.title: Ocean's Eleven

programme.desc: Shakespeare's king of England (Kenneth Branagh) attacks France and declares his love for the French king's daughter.
programme.title: Henry V

programme.desc: Blondie (Penny Singleton) tries to help when Dagwood (Arthur Lake) loses his job and is forced to work for a construction company.
programme.title: Blondie Hits the Jackpot

programme.desc: After a successful baseball career in college and as a coach in the military, Jackie Robinson attracts the attention of Major League Baseball's Branch Rickey.
programme.title: The Jackie Robinson Story

programme.desc: A St. Louis lawyer's (Leon Ames) family (Judy Garland, Margaret O'Brien) stays in town for the 1904 World's Fair.
programme.title: Meet Me in St. Louis

programme.desc: Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Watson (Nigel Bruce) follow a popular matchbook full of microfilm sought by Nazi spies.
programme.title: Sherlock Holmes in Washington

programme.desc: A peace officer settles a quarrel between twins, the offspring of an American Indian mother and a white father.
programme.title: White Comanche

programme.desc: A librarian hears a sour note when a charming rogue convinces Iowa townspeople to start a boys marching band.
programme.title: The Music Man

programme.desc: A couple (Ron Howard, Cindy Williams) and their high-school friends do their own things on four mid-1960s New Year's Eves.
programme.title: More American Graffiti

programme.desc: Armed with their proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls, slimy specters, and full-torso, free-roaming apparitions across New York.
programme.title: Ghostbusters

programme.desc: A missionary (Leo Genn) in Kenya tells a drifter (Cornel Wilde) his uranium-miner brother has been killed by leopard men.
programme.title: Beyond Mombasa

programme.desc: Superspy Derek Flint (James Coburn), agent of Z.O.W.I.E., stops a geothermal plot to control the world's weather.
programme.title: Our Man Flint

programme.desc: A traveling salesman (Edmond O'Brien) with a wife (Joan Fontaine) in San Francisco marries a waitress (Ida Lupino) in Los Angeles.
programme.title: The Bigamist

programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Christopher Plummer) and Dr. Watson (James Mason) hunt Victorian London's Jack the Ripper, despite Scotland Yard.
programme.title: Murder by Decree

programme.desc: A Greek sponge diver (Robert Wagner) in Florida loves the daughter (Terry Moore) of a rival family of Key West sponge hookers.
programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef

programme.desc: Heroic PT boat captains (Robert Montgomery, John Wayne) fight Japanese ships in the World War II Philippines.
programme.title: They Were Expendable

programme.desc: U.S. soldiers (Van Johnson, John Hodiak, Ricardo Montalban) from all over fight in the Battle of the Bulge.
programme.title: Battleground

programme.desc: Two sailors (Frank Sinatra, Gene Kelly) on leave in Hollywood help an actress (Kathryn Grayson) get her big break.
programme.title: Anchors Aweigh

programme.desc: A group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett.
programme.title: The Great Escape

programme.desc: Flamboyant Gen. George S. Patton (George C. Scott) receives accolades and censure as he fights World War II.
programme.title: Patton

programme.desc: Slapstick comedy from Larry, Moe, Curly and occasionally Shemp.
programme.title: The Three Stooges

programme.desc: S05 E09 — Lucy Gets Caught in the Draft Lucy is drafted into the Marines.
programme.title: The Lucy Show

programme.desc: A reformed outlaw's (Elvis Presley) old gang tries to frame him for the theft of a jeweled Mexican cannon.
programme.title: Charro!

programme.desc: Rejected by a young woman (Hayley Mills) in London, a scientist (John Hurt) retreats to Antarctica to study the penguin.
programme.title: Mr. Forbush and the Penguins

programme.desc: Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Watson (Nigel Bruce) follow a popular matchbook full of microfilm sought by Nazi spies.
programme.title: Sherlock Holmes in Washington

programme.desc: A detective (Peter O'Toole) helps a French art forger's daughter (Audrey Hepburn) steal a fake Venus.
programme.title: How to Steal a Million

programme.desc: A newspaper editor (Jeffrey Lynn) blasts big business, then needs a big-business man's (Donald Crisp) help.
programme.title: Home Town Story

programme.desc: The Bumsteads' dog poses for pictures and makes more money than Dagwood.
programme.title: Life With Blondie

programme.desc: A GI (John Forsythe) falls for a U.S. ambassador's daughter (Olivia de Havilland) who fights a senator's plan to make Paris off limits.
programme.title: The Ambassador's Daughter

programme.desc: When an outlaw (Lee Marvin) with a fake nose kills her father, a schoolmarm (Jane Fonda) hires his drunken twin to get revenge.
programme.title: Cat Ballou

programme.desc: A goofy astronaut (Don Knotts) with a fear of heights becomes assistant janitor, then goes on a space mission.
programme.title: The Reluctant Astronaut

programme.desc: A Greek partisan (Telly Savalas) helps Allied prisoners escape with ancient art from a German major's (Roger Moore) island prison.
programme.title: Escape to Athena

programme.desc: To evade gangsters, two men (Tony Curtis, Jack Lemmon) don skirts and makeup and join an all-girl band with a sizzling singer (Marilyn Monroe).
programme.title: Some Like It Hot
